declaration.candidate_semantics: All at share 0.75 with the v28/v29 residual stage, LIRF blends, outer weight 0.7 and floor. e_quarters: the 32 e24 and 32 e32 seeds as four equal tables; e_e32tilt: the e32 half raised to two thirds; e_e32only: the 32 e32 seeds alone. CPU- and GPU-trained 32-epoch tables are mixed by declaration, hardware named.

control.recipe: the combined round's selection c_e24x32_e32h (configs/adsb_ctx_v5.json), the committee mix of the expected v30
control.reproduction: the control must reproduce these (c_e24x32_e32h's combined-round development RMSE) to 1e-9 s on every recipe month before any candidate is read

execution.network_hosts: Azure arcw0-arcw7 as each is idle (worker arcwN: seeds 501+N lane A, 509+N lane B), 8 threads, tools/ctx_chain.sh configs/adsb_ctx_network_v4.json ctx_e32c <seed> runs/adsb_ctx seasonal forward refit refit12 (launcher tools/ctx_launch_dev6.sh)

external_data: adsb.lol globe_history (ODbL) via the committee's ADS-B tables and match tables
IEM weather and OurAirports runways via the timeline bundle

ens_ctx.ensemble: ens_ctx = per-fold seed mean over the 16 learners (tools/ensemble_adsb_full.py convention), every leaf checked against the declared variant, code, configuration and seed
ens_ctx.folds: seasonal (predicts 2025-01/07), forward (2025-11), refit (Jan-Nov; December leaf cache runs/december/learners/runs__adsb_ctx__ctx_s<seed>.parquet, ranking), refit12 (Jan-Dec; ranking), run in that order per seed by tools/ctx_chain.sh
ens_ctx.status: fitted and scored under adsb_ctx_v1 (its ensemble directory and December leaves unchanged)

declaration.purpose: Round E (CPU filler under the standing instruction to keep the Azure CPUs busy): 16 CPU-trained seeds (501-516) of the 32-epoch context network as ens_ctx_e32c. Does a 32-seed 32-epoch half improve the combined round's selection (configs/adsb_ctx_v5.json c_e24x32_e32h, the expected v30), whose 32-epoch half has 16 GPU seeds? Declared before any fit of these seeds.
declaration.selection: A candidate is eligible when: no recipe month is worse on ALL rows (ratio to the control <= 1.0); the mean ratio over the four recipe months is at least 0.02% below 1; and on every month where it changes a row the paired-day bootstrap 95% interval of the RMSE difference against the control lies below zero. Among eligible candidates choose the lowest mean ratio (ties by name); otherwise select nothing and keep the control. The rule of adsb_nn/nn2, unchanged.
declaration.ship: If a candidate is selected: its coverage-regime ship check (declared separately) against the control; ranking tables from the refit12 seed means; the incumbent at that time rebuilt from its export detail must reproduce its uploaded file exactly; export, independent verification, audit; upload only with the user's approval. If v30 is not the incumbent when this round is scored, the control is re-declared first.
